messages:
maria: Heads-up — AcmeCorp hit a customer-facing P1 this morning. Dedicated pool 'eu-west-2-pool-B' started returning 503s and model generation timeouts under a moderate traffic spike. SLA risk if we don't mitigate. Can someone own triage + propose a short-term workaround? :warning:

sam: Copy. Any logs / request IDs? I can start digging into worker error traces.

oncall-bot: ALERT: AcmeCorp / pool-B - 503 rate > 15% for 10m (since 1976538200). Pager duty: oncall-eng (taylor).

alex: I'm happy to take ownership for a quick mitigation. Need to confirm whether this is batcher-induced head-of-line blocking or an autoscale hole. Can someone share recent deploys?

taylor: I'm on call and will coordinate. Quick answers: 1) No infra deploys in the last 2 hrs. 2) We did push a runtime tweak to batching yesterday (rolling) but rolled back to 2% traffic at 04:00 UTC.

luis: Observed elevated KV cache miss rates for that pool in the last hour. Could be cache invalidation storm when many short prompts hit cold keys. If that's true, we can try prefix-caching or drop to lower batch sizes for AcmeCorp traffic.

sophia: Short-term workaround I can deploy: route AcmeCorp traffic to a dedicated low-batch path (disable large batching + force concurrent workers) — config change, no model change. I estimate ~20-30m to stage/canary and 1h for full rollout. Would reduce throughput but cut tail latency.

matt: If we do that, we need to update the quota/cost table for the customer and notify CS. Also confirm rollback steps.

maria: +1 on Sophia owning the workaround. @taylor can you confirm we have capacity to absorb AcmeCorp on the low-batch path without impacting other critical customers?

taylor: Quick capacity check: pool-B has 8 spare workers outside scheduled reservations. We can route ~30% of AcmeCorp traffic immediately. For full funnel we need another 30m to spin extra workers (bootstrap time ~8m each). I'll queue autoscale.

sam: While Sophia stages the config change, I'll pull application logs for the 503s and post minimal snippets. If it's a worker OOM we need a different play.

oncall-bot: NOTE: Incident channel created: #incidents/acmecorp-p1 (auto).

alex: Dependency note: the low-batch path requires a small routing hook change in the service mesh (PR ready, needs one review from eng-platform). If someone can LGTM quickly we can avoid a rollback risk.

sophia: Patching now. Will open a canary PR and link it here. Canary targets 10% AC traffic for 10m, then 50% for 20m if stable, then full.

matt: CS ping: @customer-success please update AcmeCorp contact and set expectations: temporary degraded throughput, shorter timeouts in guidance.

maria: Proposed owner list: Sophia (workaround deploy), Sam (logs/diagnostics), Taylor (capacity/autoscale), Alex (mesh PR/review). Can we commit to timelines?

sophia: ETA canary start: +12m. Full rollout: +1h from now if metrics look good.

sam: I'll post initial logs in 10m. Early look shows Spike in KV miss + queue depth rising before 503s.

taylor: Autoscale queued, will follow up on slack when workers ready.

alex: I'll ping @eng-platform-reviewers for quick LGTM on the mesh hook. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/mesh/+/diff123 (small routing flag)

sophia: Canary started at 1976540600 -> monitoring.

maria: Thanks team. Post-mortem ask: after we stabilize, let's capture triggers (cache invalidation pattern?) and a runbook step to auto-fail AcmeCorp to low-batch path when 5xx>5% for 5m. Assigning action items to owners above. :white_check_mark:

matt: Noted — I'll draft the customer comms for CS and share for review.

oncall-bot: UPDATE: Canary metrics -> tail latency down 60%, 503s reduced to 0.8% at 1976541200.

sophia: Rolling to 50% now. Monitoring for 10m.

maria: If stable, we'll keep low-batch path until we patch the root cause. Please add estimated ETA for root fix in this thread when known.

luis: For root fix, need to deploy a KV cache stabilization patch (backport) + better cache priming in model loader. ETA for patch: 2 business days if we sequence with infra. Could be 1 day with extra priority.

alex: I'll coordinate the mesh rollout and review; should be 30m to finish once LGTM.

maria: Great. Closing loop for now — I'll update the incident channel and CS once full rollout completes. Keep this thread for ownership updates. :eyes:
